string.name: clipboard_usage_desc
string.value: Used to paste content from the clipboard when editing documents

string.name: guard_msg
string.value:
The document "%s" has unsaved changes.
Save before closing?

string.name: save_text_only
string.value: ".%s" saves text content only. Merged cells, colors and column widths will be lost.

string.name: save_convert_as
string.value: ".%s" cannot be saved in this format. Save as ".%s" instead?

string.name: save_unwritable
string.value: The original file is not writable (permission expired or read-only). Your changes are kept in the app; use File > Save As to save them elsewhere.

string.name: pwd_prompt
string.value: This document is encrypted. Enter the password to open it.

string.name: enc_unsupported
string.value: This document uses an unsupported encryption method and cannot be opened.

string.name: font_del_msg
string.value:
"%s" will be deleted.
Documents using this font will fall back to a default font when reopened.

string.name: font_err_ttc
string.value: Font collections (.ttc) are not supported; use a single .ttf / .otf file

string.name: font_err_invalid
string.value: Not a valid font file (only .ttf / .otf are supported)

string.name: font_err_nofamily
string.value: The font has no family name and cannot be imported

string.name: font_err_builtin
string.value: The font "%s" is already built in

string.name: font_err_hash
string.value: Import failed (cannot compute the file fingerprint)

string.name: font_ok_dup
string.value: The font "%s" has already been imported

string.name: font_err_dupname
string.value: The font "%s" is already imported (same name, different file)

string.name: font_ok_imported
string.value: "%s" imported. It is available in newly opened documents.

string.name: font_err_notfound
string.value: Font not found (it may have been deleted)

string.name: font_del_effect
string.value: %s. Newly opened documents will no longer include it.

string.value: Cannot launch the system print service

string.value: Clipboard permission not granted. Enable it in system settings and try again.
